purpose: A statement the science engine proves (PROVEN in jdhart81/viridis-research index/certified.json) that fits a Viridis Conservation service enters this canon as a decision kernel without a human merge, and goes live when go_live is true. docs/auto_intake/README.md has the invariants and the rollback.
go_live_decision: Owner decision 2026-11-17 (Justin Hart): new kernels go live automatically once their checks pass. Set go_live to false to stop new kernels going live; entries then wait as callable code outside the live list.
rollback: python3 -m canon_core auto-intake rollback --function <id>, or revert the PR that brought the kernel in
